reply:
I've ported the server to Zig 0.16. From a clean copy, `node check.mjs` passes all 4 example cases, and the 9 unit tests (`zig build test`) pass too.

Beyond the examples, I ran a stress script against both the release build and a Debug build (the Debug build catches memory-safety bugs at runtime). It covered 1 MiB random binary values, a body one byte over the limit (gets 413), empty values, keys of 64 and 65 characters, empty keys and keys containing `/`, chunked uploads, malformed requests, 3
